name: Transvoy Logistics India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2015, Transvoy Logistics India Ltd is in the Logistics business of export, import, sales, and  trading[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
TLIL provides integrated logistics 
solutions. Its key expertise includes:
a)  NVOCC
b) Freight Forwarding
c) Custom Clearance
d) Transportation handling locally and globally
e) Advisory on MEIS License Trading

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Debtor days have increased from 75.6 to 123 days.
